blockers.detail: Provide an existing, legitimately obtained Windows 11 x64 ISO with -IsoPath. No download is performed.
An authorized administrator must provision the VM in Hyper-V Manager. Keep this checkout helper non-elevated; it never requests elevation.
Require 8 GiB currently free RAM: 4 GiB guest plus 4 GiB host headroom. Other workloads are not stopped automatically.
The fixed Windows System32 Hyper-V module manifest is absent. A running hypervisor alone does not provide a Windows VM management environment.
No Hyper-V module is loaded and no VM/switch query is executed. An administrator must verify DeskHarborP0VM and DeskHarborP0Private are unused in Hyper-V Manager.
Administrator-owned VM storage and its free space/ACL must be verified in Hyper-V Manager; workspace write permissions are not sufficient.

plan.vm_storage: Hyper-V administrator-managed protected default storage; never the workspace
steps: Administrator opens trusted Hyper-V Manager outside this helper
Verify fixed VM/switch names unused; leave existing objects untouched
Verify administrator-managed protected default VM storage and 80 GiB free
Create a new Private switch with no external adapter
Create a new Generation 2 VM with a dynamic 64 GiB VHDX in that protected storage
Set fixed 4 GiB memory / two processors and disable automatic startup
Enable Microsoft Windows Secure Boot and vTPM in VM settings
Attach provided Windows 11 ISO to guest DVD
Guest installation, boot, service provisioning and sign-in testing remain separate operator actions and not_run
